title: 1960 · Piaggio Vespa GS 150 — the owner's scooter

subject.summary: Approximate GS 150 / VS5 reconstruction from two supplied perspective photographs and published nominal dimensions. Owner-specified whitewalls, protection bars, rack, extra legshield badges and spare are distinguished from factory parts. Not a measured restoration drawing or a print-certified kit.

sources.title: Owner's 1960 Piaggio Vespa GS 150 commission
sources.ref: Owner identifies year/model and requests whitewalls, chrome protection bars, rear rack, extra legshield badges and spare wheel as personal, non-factory equipment.
